lessons.title: Lesson 7: Present Simple (I, You, We, They)
lessons.titleTranslated: 7-dars: Oddiy hozirgi zamon (I, You, We, They)

grammar.title: Present Simple (I, You, We, They)
grammar.titleTranslated: Oddiy hozirgi zamon (I, You, We, They)
grammar.explanation:
Oddiy hozirgi zamon har kuni takrorlanadigan ish yoki haqiqatni bildiradi.
**I, You, We, They** bilan fe’l asosiy shaklda (oʻzgarishsiz) keladi:

- I **work** every day. — Men har kuni ishlayman.
- They **play** football. — Ular futbol oʻynaydi.

Inkor: **do not (don’t) + fe’l**. Savol: **Do you …?**

Oʻzbek tilida fe’lga har shaxs uchun qoʻshimcha qoʻshiladi (ishla-**yman**, ishla-**ysan**), inglizchada esa fe’l oʻzgarmaydi.

grammar.title: Present Simple (He, She, It)
grammar.explanation:
**He, She, It** bilan fe’l oxiriga **-s** (yoki **-es**) qoʻshiladi:

- He **works**. — U ishlaydi.
- She **plays**. — U oʻynaydi.
- It **goes**. (-o, -s, -sh, -ch dan keyin → -es)

Inkor: **does not (doesn’t) + asosiy fe’l**. Savol: **Does he …?**

Oʻzbek tilida har shaxsga alohida qoʻshimcha qoʻshiladi, inglizchada esa -s faqat 3-shaxs birlikda — shuning uchun uni unutish oson.

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: He + works + in + an + office.

exercises.prompt: Inkorga oʻtkazing: He works on Sunday.
exercises.answer: He does not work on Sunday.

grammar.title: Do / Does Questions
grammar.explanation:
Oddiy hozirgi zamonda savol uchun **Do / Does** ni boshga qoʻyamiz:

- **Do** + I/you/we/they + fe’l? → **Do you like tea?**
- **Does** + he/she/it + fe’l? → **Does she work?**

Does dan keyin fe’l **-s siz** keladi. Qisqa javob: **Yes, I do. / No, she doesn’t.**

Oʻzbek tilida savol «-mi» yuklamasi bilan quriladi («Choy yoqtirasanmi?»); inglizchada esa «Do/Does» yordamchi fe’li SHART.

exercises.explanation: Does dan keyin fe’l s siz.
Toʻgʻri tartib: Do + you + like + coffee.

grammar.title: Can / Can't
grammar.explanation:
**Can** qobiliyat yoki imkoniyatni bildiradi (qila olmoq).
Can dan keyin fe’l **to siz va -s siz** keladi, barcha egalar uchun bir xil:

- I **can** swim. — Men suza olaman.
- She **can** dance. — U raqsga tusha oladi.

Inkor: **cannot / can’t**. Savol: **Can you …?**

Oʻzbek tilida «suza **olaman**» (fe’l + -a olmoq) deymiz; inglizchada esa can alohida soʻz.

rules.note: I can read, she can read (s siz).

exercises.explanation: can barcha egalar uchun bir xil.

grammar.title: Adverbs Of Frequency (Always / Usually / Never)
grammar.explanation:
Bu soʻzlar ish **necha marta** takrorlanishini bildiradi:

- **always** — doim (100%)
- **usually** — odatda
- **often** — tez-tez
- **sometimes** — ba’zan
- **never** — hech qachon (0%)

**Gapdagi oʻrni ikki qoidaga boʻysunadi:**

- Oddiy fe’l bilan — **fe’ldan oldin**: *I **always** drink tea.* · *She **never** works on Sunday.*
- **to be** (am / is / are) bilan — **undan keyin**: *He **is always** happy.* · *They **are never** late.*

Diqqat: **never** bilan fe’l **darak** shaklda qoladi — never oʻzi inkor. Oʻzbek tilida esa ikkilangan inkor me’yoriy («hech qachon ichmayman»), inglizchada yoʻq.

Misol: *I **always** drink tea, but I **never** drink coffee.*

examples.sentence: I always get up at seven.
We usually eat dinner at home.
examples.translation: Biz odatda kechki ovqatni uyda yeymiz.

examples.sentence: She sometimes reads a book in the evening.
He is always happy at school.

rules.pattern: ma’no: always → usually → often → sometimes → never
rules.note: 100% dan 0% gacha: doim, odatda, tez-tez, ba’zan, hech qachon
I always work. · She never reads.

rules.pattern: to be (am / is / are) dan keyin
rules.note: He is always happy. · They are never late.

rules.pattern: never bilan fe’l darak shaklda qoladi
rules.note: I never drink coffee. (never don’t emas)

exercises.promptTranslated: Biz odatda kechki ovqatni uyda yeymiz.
U yakshanba kuni tez-tez futbol oʻynaydi.
exercises.explanation: tez-tez → often; oddiy fe’l bilan to be kerak emas.

exercises.prompt: She ___ a book in the evening. (ba’zan)

exercises.explanation: Oddiy fe’l bilan: always get up.

exercises.promptTranslated: U maktabga hech qachon kech qolmaydi.
exercises.explanation: late — sifat, to be kerak, ravish is DAN KEYIN.
to be bilan ravish are dan keyin keladi.
never oʻzi inkor — fe’l darak shaklda qoladi.

comps.title: Reading Practice
comps.passage: Every morning, I wake up at seven o'clock. I wash my face and brush my teeth. I eat breakfast and go to school. I study English. In the evening I watch TV with my family. I go to bed at ten.
comps.passageTranslated: Har ertalab men soat yettida uygʻonaman. Yuzimni yuvaman va tishlarimni yuvaman. Nonushta qilaman va maktabga boraman. Men ingliz tilini oʻrganaman. Kechqurun oilam bilan televizor tomosha qilaman. Soat oʻnda uxlayman.

comps.title: Listening: My Day
comps.passage: I get up at seven o'clock. I have breakfast and go to school. In the afternoon I do my homework. In the evening I watch TV with my family. I go to bed at ten o'clock. I am never late for school in the morning.
comps.passageTranslated: Men soat yettida turaman. Nonushta qilaman va maktabga boraman. Tushdan keyin uy vazifamni bajaraman. Kechqurun oilam bilan televizor tomosha qilaman. Soat oʻnda uxlayman. Ertalab maktabga hech qachon kech qolmayman.

comps.title: A Daily Routine
comps.passage: Let's review daily routines! I always get up at seven o'clock. I wash my face and eat breakfast. Then I go to school. In the evening I watch TV. I never go to bed late.
comps.passageTranslated: Keling, kundalik tartibni takrorlaymiz! Men doim soat yettida turaman. Yuzimni yuvaman va nonushta qilaman. Keyin maktabga boraman. Kechqurun televizor tomosha qilaman. Hech qachon kech uxlamayman.

questions.question: When does he get up?
questions.explanation: Matn: I always get up at seven o'clock.

questions.question: What does he do in the evening?

comps.title: Karim’s Morning
comps.passage: Karim is a student. He gets up at six o'clock. He washes his face and eats breakfast. Then he goes to school. After school he does his homework and reads a book. In the evening he watches TV with his family. He can play football, but he cannot swim. He goes to bed at ten.
comps.passageTranslated: Karim talaba. U soat oltida turadi. U yuzini yuvadi va nonushta qiladi. Keyin maktabga boradi. Maktabdan keyin uy vazifasini bajaradi va kitob oʻqiydi. Kechqurun oilasi bilan televizor tomosha qiladi. U futbol oʻynay oladi, lekin suza olmaydi. U soat oʻnda uxlaydi.

questions.question: What does Karim do after school?
questions.explanation: Matn: After school he does his homework and reads a book.

questions.question: What can Karim NOT do?
questions.explanation: Matn: He can play football, but he cannot swim.

questions.explanation: Matn: He goes to bed at ten.
